# Zen Notes

> Sticky-note style block-notes widget for Zen Browser, distributed as a Sine mod. Plain chrome JS + CSS, no runtime dependencies. Source in `src/`; Sine manifest in `theme.json`.

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): commands, conventions, hard rules for agents
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): layout, module contract, runtime flow, Sine contract

## Reference
- [docs/storage.md](docs/storage.md): notes.json schema v5, locking, migration, deprecated v4 mirror
- [docs/editor.md](docs/editor.md): selection mapping, rendering, history, IME
- [docs/theming.md](docs/theming.md): tokens, Sticky default, adding a palette
- [docs/release.md](docs/release.md): channels, bump, CI, why updatedAt/homepage matter
- [docs/decisions/](docs/decisions/): short ADRs
